1.text: Zaburi iyi y'ishimwe ni iya Dawidi.Mana yanjye, Mwami wanjye ndagushyira hejuru,Nzahimbaza izina ryawe iteka ryose.

2.text: Nzajya nguhimbaza uko bukeye,Nzashima izina ryawe iteka ryose.

3.text: Uwiteka arakomeye ni uwo gushimwa cyane,Gukomera kwe ntikurondoreka.

4.text: Ab'igihe bazashimira ab'ikindi gihe imirimo yawe,Bababwire iby'imbaraga wakoze.

5.text: Nzavuga ubwiza bw'icyubahiro cyo gukomera kwawe,N'imirimo itangaza wakoze.

6.text: Abantu bazavuga imbaraga z'imirimo yawe iteye ubwoba,Nanjye nzavuga gukomera kwawe.

7.text: Bazībukiriza kugira neza kwawe kwinshi,Baririmbe gukiranuka kwawe.

8.text: Uwiteka ni umunyambabazi n'umunyebambe,Atinda kurakara afite kugira neza kwinshi.

9.text: Uwiteka agirira neza bose,Imbabazi ze ziri ku byo yaremye byose.

10.text: Uwiteka, ibyo waremye byose bizagushima,Abakunzi bawe bazaguhimbaza.

11.text: Bazavuga icyubahiro cy'ubwami bwawe,Bamamaze imbaraga zawe,

12.text: Kugira ngo bamenyeshe abantu iby'imbaraga yakoze,N'icyubahiro cy'ubwiza cy'ubwami bwe.

13.text: Ubwami bwawe ni ubw'iteka ryose,Ubutware bwawe buzahoraho ibihe byose.

14.text: Uwiteka aramira abagwa bose,Yemesha abahetamye bose.

15.text: Amaso y'ibintu byose aragutegereza,Nawe ukabigaburira ibyokurya byabyo igihe cyabyo.

16.text: Upfumbatura igipfunsi cyawe,Ugahaza kwifuza kw'ibibaho byose.

17.text: Uwiteka akiranuka mu nzira ze zose,Ni umunyarukundo mu mirimo ye yose.

18.text: Uwiteka aba hafi y'abamutakira bose,Abamutakira mu by'ukuri bose.

19.text: Azasohoza ibyo abamwubaha bashaka,Kandi azumva gutaka kwabo abakize.

20.text: Uwiteka arinda abamukunda bose,Ariko abanyabyaha bose azabarimbura.

21.text: Akanwa kanjye kazavuga ishimwe ry'Uwiteka,Abafite umubiri bose bajye bahimbaza izina rye ryera iteka ryose.
